codingProjects.name: Coding & Programming
codingProjects.description: Design and build a standalone computer program that solves a specific problem or completes a defined task. You will demonstrate the finished application and explain your programming decisions, logic, and development process.

codingProjects.name: Computer Game & Simulation Programming
codingProjects.description: Create an interactive game or simulation based on the FBLA topic. The project should demonstrate programming ability, problem-solving, creativity, and thoughtful game or simulation design.

codingProjects.name: Data Analysis
codingProjects.description: Analyze a provided data set, identify meaningful patterns or insights, and communicate your conclusions using effective data visualizations. You will present your analysis and explain how the information could support decision-making.

codingProjects.name: Introduction to Programming
codingProjects.discription: 9th/10th grade only. Develop a basic computer program based on the assigned FBLA topic. You will demonstrate the working program and explain how your code, logic, and design solve the assigned challenge.

codingProjects.name: Mobile Application Development
codingProjects.description: Design and build a functional mobile application based on the current FBLA topic. The finished app should demonstrate useful functionality, effective interface design, creativity, and technical problem-solving.

codingProjects.name: Website Coding & Development
codingProjects.description: Build a functioning website based on the assigned topic, with an emphasis on programming and functionality rather than appearance alone. You will demonstrate the working site and explain the technical choices behind it.

codingProjects.name: Website Design
codingProjects.description: Create a visually appealing, easy-to-use website based on the assigned topic. This event emphasizes front-end design, layout, navigation, usability, and the overall user experience.

businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.name: Business Plan
businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.description: Develop a complete business plan for a new or existing business idea. You will explain the business concept, target market, competition, marketing strategy, operations, financial planning, and how the business could succeed.

businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.name: Event Planning
businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.description: Create a detailed plan for an event based on the assigned FBLA topic. Your project should address the event purpose, audience, schedule, location, budget, promotion, logistics, and other details needed to successfully organize and manage the event.

businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.name: Introduction to Business Presentation
businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.description: 9th–10th grade only. Develop and deliver a professional business presentation based on the assigned FBLA topic. Your presentation should clearly communicate your ideas, use effective visuals, and demonstrate strong organization and presentation skills.

businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.name: Introduction to Social Media Strategy
businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.description: 9th–10th grade only. Develop a social media strategy based on the assigned FBLA topic. You will identify the target audience, choose appropriate platforms, plan content and messaging, and explain how the strategy could help achieve the organization’s goals.

businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.name: Sales Presentation
businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.description: Create and deliver a persuasive sales presentation for a product or service. You will identify customer needs, explain important features and benefits, respond to possible concerns, and use professional communication techniques to persuade the customer.

businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.name: Social Media Strategies
businessMarketingEntrepreneurship.description: Develop a detailed social media strategy for the assigned FBLA topic. Your plan should identify the target audience, appropriate platforms, content strategy, branding, engagement methods, and ways to measure whether the campaign is successful.

graphicDesign.name: Digital Animation
graphicDesign.description: Create an original digital animation based on the assigned FBLA topic. The finished project should demonstrate creativity, effective storytelling or communication, visual design skills, and appropriate use of animation techniques and digital tools.

graphicDesign.name: Digital Video Production
graphicDesign.description: Plan, record, edit, and produce an original digital video based on the assigned FBLA topic. Your project should demonstrate effective storytelling, audio and visual quality, editing skills, creativity, and clear communication of the intended message.

graphicDesign.name: Graphic Design
graphicDesign.description: Create original graphic design materials based on the assigned FBLA topic. Your work should demonstrate strong visual communication, effective use of typography, color, layout, imagery, and a consistent design style appropriate for the intended audience.

graphicDesign.name: Public Service Announcement
graphicDesign.description: Create an original public service announcement based on the assigned FBLA topic. The finished project should communicate a clear message, appeal to the intended audience, encourage awareness or action, and demonstrate effective visual and media production skills.

graphicDesign.name: Visual Design
graphicDesign.description: Create a visual design solution based on the assigned FBLA topic. Your project should demonstrate creativity, effective layout, typography, color choices, visual hierarchy, and a clear connection between the design and its intended purpose and audience.
